## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should use the same revision identifier as history and completion. Its seven-character truncation should be corrected to match their 12-character output.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status(revision, 2)` displays `0123456` while history and completion display `0123456789ab`. The status docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but this slice uses seven characters instead of 12. Use the same truncation and assert the complete status string; the added test checks only its prefix and attempt suffix. — Users see inconsistent revision identifiers across deployment outputs, making them harder to correlate.

(none)

- Tests verify attempt formatting for multiple attempt numbers.
- Existing assertions retain the expected history and completion output.
